candidate.answerReason: Equal supplements give 2x+10=3x−20, hence x=30. The resulting angles are 70°, 110°, and 70°, satisfying both supplementary sums.

methods.label: Equate the two supplements
methods.explanation: Supplements of the same angle are equal, so \(\angle 1=\angle 3\). Thus \(2x+10=3x-20\), which gives \(x=30\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 same-angle supplement property followed by a linear equation of the form ax+b=cx+d.
